note: Recompiler-only names for static (boot segment) libultra functions. N64Recomp replaces libultra functions BY NAME with N64ModernRuntime implementations (reimplemented list) or drops them (ignored list), so the name the recompiler sees decides what runs. These are the functions whose recompiler name must differ from the decompilation's current (ultralib VERSION_J) name: a canonical name that is on N64Recomp's lists but must stay emitted (or is shimmed, patches.json) gets suffix _rx; the three PI raw functions keep their pre-J names (osPiRawStartDma, osEPiRawStartDma) that N64Recomp knows, while VERSION_J spells them __osPiRawStartDma/__osEPiRawStartDma/__osPiRawReadIo; and functions the decompilation renamed after the recompiled output was first verified are mapped back to their former names (the ultralib ll.c/llcvt.c helpers to their libgcc names, and the later ultralib identifications) so the recompiled output stays unchanged. The renames apply to the recompiler's symbol file only. 'inventory' is the decompilation's name; 'evidence' is what identifies the body.
